About us

Not a substitute. A choice.

Spirito Libero was born from a simple question: why give up the aperitivo ritual just because you choose to drink less alcohol? Today in Italy 63% of people regularly choose alcohol-free aperitifs. We designed ours for those who don't want to give up flavour.

Flavour first

No industrial syrups or fruit juice dressed up as a cocktail. Recipes designed to recreate the aromatic complexity of the great classics: bitter, citrusy, botanical.

Zebra striping, not abstinence

We don't ask you to stop drinking alcohol. We offer the alternative for the occasions when you want to stay clear-headed, drive, or simply feel better the next day — without leaving the social ritual of the aperitivo.

Ready, no compromises

1L bottle, ready to pour over ice. No bartender gear, the same quality as a drink made at the bar.

A growing market, a taste that doesn't compromise

The global market for premium non-alcoholic drinks is now worth over 9.6 billion euros. It is not a passing fad: it is a cultural shift in how the aperitivo is lived. We want to be the leading Italian brand for those who live it with taste, not out of renunciation.
